name: FormFabric
kind: Garment design and cloth simulation app
title: sewing patterns draped on a body with a real cloth simulation
summary: FormFabric is a garment design app: draw pattern pieces, sew them edge to edge, drape them with a real cloth simulation, animate and export. Agents drive it over MCP.
lede: FormFabric is for garment design. You draw pattern pieces in millimetres, sew them edge to edge, drape them on a body with a native cloth solver, animate the result and export it, all in one window on your own computer. Every action is one engine command, so the window, a Python script and an AI agent over MCP drive the same document.
checks: Draws pattern panels in millimetres with exact numeric input, darts, notches and seam allowance.
Settles fabric under gravity, contact and seams with a native cloth solver and an opt-in GPU path on Metal, Vulkan and DX12.
Exports OBJ, FBX, glTF, USD and Alembic with UVs and caches, or saves the whole garment as a .ffbrc project.
Declares 255 engine commands once, so the interface, the Python package and the MCP server call the same ones.

facts.dd: A Rust workspace of 14 crates, with a native cloth solver (block descent and implicit) and an opt-in wgpu compute path
Vanilla TypeScript and Vite, with the shared Form shell, zero flash on load and every string in 30 languages
255 engine commands in one registry, shared by the UI, the Python package and the MCP server

chapters.title: Draw panels, then sew them
chapters.text: Flat panels carry seams, darts, grain lines and notches, with a live seam check in millimetres. Draw them with numeric input and seam allowance, and exchange them as DXF-AAMA.

chapters.title: Real cloth on a real body
chapters.text: A native solver settles the fabric under gravity, contact and seams, with Fast, Normal, Quality and Final presets. Drape on CC0 MPFB2 bodies or a Basic Form, then refit and re-drape as the pattern changes.

chapters.title: One registry of 255 commands
chapters.text: The UI, the Python package and the MCP server call the same engine commands. ./formfabric mcp runs an MCP server on stdio for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.

requirements: Rust at the version pinned by rust-toolchain.toml (installed by rustup)
docs.agents: ./formfabric mcp runs an MCP server on stdio for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. .mcp.json, .codex/config.toml and .cursor/mcp.json are already wired in the repository.

topics.title: Run from source
topics.text: ./formfabric serves the web UI at http://localhost:5280 and ./formfabric desktop dev opens the desktop window. The backend listens on 127.0.0.1:8280 only, and ./formfabric doctor checks the requirements.

topics.title: Scripting
topics.text: A standard-library Python package drives the engine: ./formfabric py -m formfabric commands lists the commands and ./formfabric py my_script.py runs a script.

topics.title: Where things live
topics.text: native holds the engine, frontend the interface, backend the service, python the package and src-tauri the desktop shell.

topics.title: Status
topics.text: FormFabric is pre-1.0. The GPU path and solver speed on real hardware, the Unreal run and a few other items still wait for sign-off before v1.0.0.

topics.title: Releases
topics.text: All FormFabric builds are compiled and released from FormCompiler; the repository holds the source.
